text:
elaine: Quick sync — proposed experiment for the upcoming webinar launch. Goal: boost activation (first-week DAU) from webinar attendees using a PLG funnel test: free starter credits + tailored prompt templates. High-level plan:

elaine: 1) Cohorts: A = 50 starter credits + generic prompt pack, B = 75 starter credits + personalized prompt pack (based on use-case selection during signup).
elaine: 2) Distribution: assign credits at account creation if `webinar_attendee=true` or via post-signup webhook for late registrants.
elaine: 3) Messaging: launch posts + webinar follow-up email -> immediate CTA to try prompt templates in-app.
elaine: 4) Success metrics: activation rate (7-day), prompt usage per user, conversion to paid in 30d, token consumption.

sam: Nice. Timeline? Who owns the follow-up email copy and the creative for the prompt pack? Also want to A/B the subject line vs body nudges.

miguel: I can take the prompt pack creative. Recommendation: two prompt bundles — "Getting Productive" (task automation templates) and "Customer Ops" (summarization + routing). Use distinct benchmark narratives for each in the landing/launch post so analytics can attribute which bundle drives stickiness.

miguel: For copy variants: Version 1 = benefit-forward ("Ship features faster"), Version 2 = micro-case ("How X used prompts to save 3 hrs/week").

tori: Routing + tagging notes: we'll mark users with trait `webinar_attendee:true` and `webinar_cohort: A|B`. Post-signup webhook will call accounts.assignCredits. Quick snippet for the tracking hook:

```js
analytics.track({
  userId: user.id,
  event: "webinar_credit_assign",
  properties: { cohort: "A", credits: 50, source: "webinar_followup" }
});
// then call internal API: POST /internal/assign-credits { user_id, credits, reason }
```

tori: QA checklist: ensure credits show in billing dashboard, prompt pack appears in templates modal, and onboarding tour points to "Try a template".

zach: Suggest a staged rollout: canary 10% of registrants -> 30% -> full. Add a day-1 and day-3 nudge email sequence for non-activated users. Sample cadence: day0 (welcome + prompt pack), day1 (how-to quick tips), day3 (offer extra creds if try 2+ prompts).
zach: Tracking: tag emails with `utm_campaign=wb_launch_v1` and send cohort id to Mixpanel so we can compute lift. Key KPI = delta in 7-day activation between A and B (stat sig target 80% power).

elaine: We'll need a short benchmark narrative for public launch posts — something that highlights "ship faster with starter prompts + credits" and calls out the webinar recording + prompt bundle. Miguel — can you draft 2 headline options? Sam — do you want to own the landing CTA and subject line tests?

miguel: Yep, will drop two headline options by EOD.
sam: I'll own CTA/subject lines and set up the experiment in Optimizely. I'll also coordinate with Growth on the email template.

tori: I'll stub the webhook and post-signup flow today, and add unit tests for credits assignment.

campaign-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Prep webinar followups + prompt packs — confirm assets by 4412345750" :bell:

elaine: Next steps: owners (Miguel copy + prompt packs, Sam CTA/experiments, Tori routing), list final assets in the PRD thread, and we'll meet Fri 10am to review canary criteria. Any blockers?

sam: Need confirm from Legal on credits expiration text. Will ping them now.
miguel: No blockers from my side.
tori: I'll post the QA steps once the webhook PR is up.

elaine: Awesome — thanks everyone. We'll capture the benchmark baseline tomorrow and share the measurement doc in #marketing. :rocket:
